system_info.name: VIET_BAO_PRO_EDU_VISUAL_SYSTEM_v2
system_info.core_mission: Transform abstract AI concepts into tangible, physical, and high-value tools for E-learning.

philosophy.tangible_knowledge_concept: Knowledge must look like a solid tool. Abstract concepts = Physical Blocks/Cards. Processes = Mechanical Assemblies.

design_system.lighting: Soft studio lighting, diffused, ambient occlusion, no harsh spotlights.

anchored_icon_system.rule: MANDATORY: Never generate floating icons. Every symbol must be physically anchored.

structure.anchor: Button, tile, thick card, or cube
structure.icon: Engraved, printed, or embossed onto the Anchor
structure.physics: Object casts shadow, icon does not

anchored_icon_system.visual_check: A dark square tile sitting on a table with a 'Play' triangle engraved > A floating 'Play' triangle.

presentation_slide.negative_space: CRITICAL: Leave 40-50% empty dark background for text overlay

vertical_infographic.flow: Vertical stack connected by gold lines/cables
vertical_infographic.aesthetic: High-end physical dashboard or stack of premium flashcards

requirements: Render Vietnamese text exactly as typed
Text must look physically applied (embossed, gold-leafed, screen-printed)
Use bold, geometric Sans-Serif fonts (Inter/Roboto style)
Headlines: Embossed Gold or Bright Off-White
Subtext: Muted Grey, printed on surface

validation_checklist: Is the icon/text anchored to a physical object?
Is there enough empty space for a slide?
Is the Sci-fi look completely removed?
